name: Oysters
description: Functional group aggregating the source's oyster compartment - overwhelmingly the eastern oyster (Crassostrea virginica) on Bay reefs - kept plural because the source measured the suspension-feeding oyster stock as a whole. Filters phytoplankton, suspended detritus and microzooplankton from the estuarine water column; nothing in the network eats it. Reported biomass (metrics.biomass) is the annual mean in mgC/m2.
